scope: Description of the native call each adapter wraps and of the controlled depth index. Placeholders in braces are filled from the full configuration (model section) and from the site arithmetic of cross_morse/core.py; the A0 tuple is read from the ACTIONS registry.

ogbn-arxiv.native_call: shared-weight propagation step after the encoder
ogbn-arxiv.depth_index: ℓ indexes the {depth} unrolled applications of the shared transport step; native layer = step

ogbn-proteins.native_call: edge-weighted propagation step; edge features enter the kernel weights

ogbn-products.native_call: full-graph sparse propagation step; dense updates chunked at {dense_chunk_size} rows

Roman-empire.native_call: heterophily-aware propagation step: ego and neighbour representations enter the native update separately; the neighbour aggregation is a nonnegative degree-normalized mean

PascalVOC-SP.native_call: local MPNN branch of each GPS block; global-attention branch untouched
PascalVOC-SP.depth_index: {depth} controlled transport sites: {substeps} sub-steps per native block plus {boundary} boundary sites at the encoder and decoder; A0 executes the native aggregation at the one designated site of each block and the identity (ν = 0) at the other sub-steps, so the nominal trajectory is the native one and the controller adds transport only at non-native sites

Peptides-func.native_call: degree-normalized linear aggregation of the trained plant; the standard nonlinear GINE message is not used
Peptides-func.depth_index: {depth} controlled transport sites: {substeps} sub-steps per native layer, one designated native site per layer
Peptides-func.a0: yes (designated-site convention; identity error in Table S5c)
